ourStoryP1: Founded with a vision to redefine global commerce, CAMION ONLINE TRADING is building one of the region's most advanced AI-powered eCommerce and logistics ecosystems. CAMION connects customers in the GCC with millions of products directly from international suppliers through a seamless, technology-driven shopping experience.
ourStoryP2: Powered by intelligent procurement systems, AI-enabled automation, real-time logistics integration, and scalable infrastructure, CAMION is designed to simplify cross-border trade for modern consumers. From product discovery and automated sourcing to warehouse management and last-mile delivery, every part of the ecosystem is engineered to provide speed, transparency, and affordability.
ourStoryP3: Today, CAMION is rapidly expanding across the GCC with a growing network of suppliers, logistics partners, influencers, and technology specialists working together to build the future of digital commerce.
ourStoryP4: CAMION offers access to millions of products across multiple categories including fashion, electronics, home essentials, beauty products, lifestyle accessories, and much more — all through a unified and customer-focused platform.

faqHeroDescription: Find quick answers about shopping, orders, your account, security, and more.
faqPolicyHint: Need more details? Read the full policies page for complete information.
faqOrdersQ1: How do I place an order on Camion?
faqOrdersA1: Browse products, add items to your cart, proceed to checkout, and complete payment using one of our available payment methods.
faqOrdersQ2: Can I order multiple products together?
faqOrdersA2: Yes. Multiple products can be purchased within a single order.
faqOrdersQ3: Can I modify my order after placing it?
faqOrdersA3: Orders may be modified before processing begins. Once processing starts, changes may not be possible.
faqOrdersA4: Orders can be cancelled before shipment. After shipment, cancellation may not be available.
faqOrdersQ5: How do I cancel an order?
faqOrdersA5: Go to My Orders → Select Order → Cancel Order.
faqOrdersQ6: How can I check my order status?
faqOrdersA6: You can check your order status through Track Order page by using the tracking number provided.
faqOrdersQ7: Will I receive an order confirmation?
faqOrdersA7: Yes, an order confirmation email will be sent immediately after your purchase.
faqOrdersQ8: Where can I see my orders?
faqOrdersA8: Visit My Orders page in your Camion account.
faqOrdersQ9: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
faqOrdersA9: Address changes are possible only before order processing starts.
faqOrdersQ10: Can I change product quantities after ordering?
faqOrdersA10: No. A new order may need to be placed.
faqOrdersQ11: How do I leave a review?
faqOrdersA11: Visit your completed orders and select "Write a Review."
faqOrdersQ12: Why can't I post a review?
faqOrdersA12: Reviews are available only for delivered orders.
faqShippingA1: Your order is being prepared and verified before shipment.
faqShippingA2: Your package has been packed and is awaiting carrier pickup.
faqShippingQ3: Which countries does Camion ship to?
faqShippingA3: Camion currently ships to all GCC countries.
faqShippingA4: Most orders are delivered within 6–18 business days, although delivery times may vary depending on the destination and operational circumstances. Delivery time information can also be found in Shipping Policy section.
faqShippingA5: Yes. Every order includes shipment tracking through your Camion account. You can track your order through Track Order page by providing tracking number.
faqShippingQ6: Why are delivery times longer than local stores?
faqShippingA6: Many products are sourced through Camion's global supplier network, allowing access to a wider range of products and competitive prices.
faqShippingA7: Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on product weight, dimensions, and destination.
faqShippingA8: Promotional free shipping offers may apply to eligible orders. You also may qualify for free shipping once you exceed the threshold.
faqShippingQ9: What if my package is marked delivered but I did not receive it?
faqShippingA9: Contact customer support immediately for investigation.
faqShippingQ10: Will all my items arrive together?
faqShippingA10: Eligible items within the same order are consolidated into a single parcel. Some products may be shipped separately due to shipping or operational requirements.
faqShippingQ11: Do I need to arrange customs clearance?
faqShippingA11: No. For standard orders placed through Camion, customs clearance is coordinated through our logistics network.
faqShippingQ12: Can I change my delivery address?
faqShippingA12: Because orders begin processing shortly after payment, address changes cannot always be guaranteed. Please contact Customer Support as soon as possible if you need assistance.
faqShippingQ13: What happens if my order is delayed?
faqShippingA13: Unexpected delays may occur due to customs clearance, weather conditions, or carrier disruptions. If your order is delayed beyond the estimated delivery timeframe, please contact Customer Support. We'll work with our logistics partners to investigate the shipment and provide updates.
faqPaymentQ1: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqPaymentA1: Available payment methods may include Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal (where available), and QPay (where available). The options shown at checkout depend on your location and device.
faqPaymentQ2: Is it safe to pay on Camion?
faqPaymentA2: Yes. Payments are processed through Secure Payment infrastructure designed to help protect customer information and reduce unauthorized transactions.
faqPaymentQ3: Can I pay cash on delivery?
faqPaymentA3: Sorry, cash on delivery service is not available at the moment.
faqPaymentA4: Payments may be declined for reasons such as incorrect payment details, insufficient funds, bank security checks, or authorization issues. If the problem continues, please contact your payment provider or our Customer Support team.
faqPaymentQ5: When will I receive my refund?
faqPaymentA5: Approved refunds are generally issued to the original payment method. Processing times vary depending on your bank or payment provider.
faqPaymentQ6: Will Camion ever ask for my card details?
faqPaymentA6: No. Camion will never ask you to send your full payment card details through email, chat, social media, or messaging applications.
faqReturnsQ1: How do I request a return?
faqReturnsA1: You can submit a return request through your Camion account My Orders page.
faqReturnsQ2: How long do I have to return an item?
faqReturnsA2: Most eligible items can be returned within 15 calendar days after delivery.
faqReturnsA3: If the return is due to a Camion error or a verified product issue, Camion will generally cover the return shipping costs. For customer-preference returns, the customer is generally responsible for return shipping.
faqReturnsA4: No. At this time, Camion does not offer direct exchanges. Eligible items can be returned in accordance with Returns & Refunds policy, and a new order can be placed separately.
faqReturnsQ5: How long does a refund take?
faqReturnsA5: After your return has been approved and inspected, refunds are generally processed within 5 to 10 business days, although your payment provider may require additional time.
faqReturnsA6: Yes. Returns may be declined if they do not meet the eligibility requirements of Returns & Refunds policy or if fraud, misuse, or other policy violations are identified.
faqProductA1: We strive to ensure all product images accurately represent the products offered. Minor variations may occur.
faqProductQ2: Why does the product I received look slightly different from the photos?
faqProductA2: Differences in screen settings, manufacturing updates, or product variations may result in minor differences.
faqProductA3: Products may undergo quality checks before shipment.
faqProductQ4: What if I ordered the wrong size?
faqProductA4: Please review the Returns & Refunds policy.
faqProductQ5: Why is a product out of stock?
faqProductA6: Yes. Use the Notify Me feature when available.
faqProtectionQ1: Does every order include Buyer Protection?
faqProtectionA1: Buyer Protection applies to eligible purchases made through the Camion platform and is subject to our applicable policies and terms.
faqProtectionQ2: How quickly should I report an issue?
faqProtectionA2: We recommend reporting any order-related issue as soon as reasonably possible after delivery so our team can investigate while information is still available. Specific reporting deadlines may apply under our Returns & Refunds Policy.
faqProtectionQ3: Will I need to provide photos?
faqProtectionA3: Depending on the issue, we may request photographs, videos, or other supporting information to help us assess your claim accurately.
faqProtectionQ4: Can I contact Customer Support directly?
faqProtectionA4: Yes. If you need assistance at any stage of your shopping journey, our Customer Support team is available 24/7 in English and Arabic.
faqProtectionQ5: How long does the review process take?
faqProtectionA5: Review times vary depending on the complexity of the case and the information required. Our goal is always to resolve eligible requests as efficiently as possible while ensuring a fair review.
faqProtectionQ6: What if I receive a damaged item?
faqProtectionA6: Contact us immediately with photos and order details. We will investigate the case and provide an appropriate resolution.
faqProtectionQ7: What if I receive the wrong product?
faqProtectionA7: We will review the issue and arrange a refund or other suitable resolution.
faqProtectionQ8: What if my order never arrives?
faqProtectionA8: If your order is confirmed lost during transit, we will investigate the case and offer a suitable resolution according to the case.
faqProtectionA9: We offer support for eligible orders involving damaged, defective, incorrect, or undelivered items.

faqAccountA1: Customers may shop as guests where available, but creating an account offers additional benefits.
faqAccountA2: Possible reasons include Incorrect password, Unverified account, or Temporary security restrictions.

faqAccountA3: Use the "Forgot Password" option on the login page.

faqAccountA9Step6: Verify the number using the one-time verification code sent to your device.
faqAccountA9Outro: Your phone number may be used for order updates, delivery notifications, and account security verification.
faqAccountA10Intro: You can customize your notification preferences at any time:
faqAccountA10Step3: Choose which notifications you would like to receive.
faqAccountQ11: How do I update my shipping address?
faqAccountA11Step1: Log in to your Camion account.
faqAccountA11Step3: Add a new address or edit an existing one.
faqAccountA11Outro: Address updates may not be possible after an order has entered processing or shipment stages.
faqAccountQ12: How do I delete my account?
faqAccountA12Intro: If you wish to permanently delete your Camion account:
faqAccountA12Step5: Follow the verification steps to confirm your request.
faqAccountA12Outro: Please note that account deletion is permanent. Once your account is deleted, you may lose access to your order history, saved addresses, wishlists, and other account-related information.
faqAccountA12Outro2: Certain information may be retained where required by applicable laws, regulations, or legitimate business purposes.
faqAccountQ13: How do I make my account more secure?
faqAccountA13Intro: To help protect your account, we recommend the following:
faqAccountA13Item1: Use a strong and unique password.
faqAccountA13Item3: Verify your email address and mobile number.
faqAccountA13Item4: Do not share your login credentials with anyone.
faqAccountA13Item6: Sign out when using shared or public devices.
faqAccountA13Item7: Be cautious of phishing emails or messages requesting account information.
faqAccountA13Outro: If you suspect unauthorized access to your account, change your password immediately and contact Camion Customer Support for assistance.
faqSecurityQ1: How do I recognize phishing emails and messages?
faqSecurityA1Text1: Fraudulent emails and messages often attempt to obtain your login credentials, payment information, or verification codes.
faqSecurityA1Item1: Never share passwords or verification codes.
faqSecurityA1Item4: Access your account only through the official Camion website or mobile application.
faqSecurityA1Outro: If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Camion, please report it to our Customer Support team.
faqSecurityQ2: Why was my account temporarily restricted?
faqSecurityA2Intro: Your account may be temporarily restricted for security reasons, including:
faqSecurityA2Outro: If you believe the restriction was applied in error, please contact Customer Support.
faqSecurityQ3: How does Camion protect my personal data?
faqSecurityA3Intro: Camion uses industry-standard security measures designed to protect personal information, including:
faqSecurityA3Outro: For more information, please review our Privacy Policy.
faqPromoA1: Promo codes can be entered during checkout and are subject to their respective terms and conditions.
faqPromoQ2: Can I use more than one coupon on the same order?
faqPromoA2: No. Unless specifically stated otherwise, only one coupon can be applied to a single order.
faqPromoA3: Yes. Every promotional coupon has an expiry date, which will be displayed as part of the campaign.
faqPromoA4: Most coupons are intended for one-time use only unless the promotion specifically states otherwise.
faqPromoQ5: Can influencer discount codes be combined with other offers?
faqPromoA5: No. Influencer promotion codes generally cannot be combined with other coupons or promotional discounts unless explicitly stated.
faqPromoQ6: What happens if I return an item purchased with a coupon?
faqPromoA6: Refunds are generally based on the amount actually paid after the applicable promotional discount has been applied. Additional adjustments may apply if the return affects eligibility for a promotion.
faqPromoA7: The coupon may have expired, reached its usage limit, or may not apply to the products in your cart.
faqTrustA1: Camion works with a global supplier network to offer customers access to a wide selection of products at competitive prices.
faqTrustA2: Products are evaluated based on supplier performance, customer demand, and quality standards.
faqTrustQ3: Does Camion manufacture the products it sells?
faqTrustA3: Camion operates as an cross-border e-commerce platform and does not manufacture products listed on the website.
faqTrustQ4: How can I contact customer support?
faqTrustA4: You can reach us through live chat, email, WhatsApp, or the Contact Us page.
faqConsolidatedQ1: Why don't my products ship immediately?
faqConsolidatedA1: Your products first move through our fulfillment process, where eligible items can be prepared together before international shipment.
faqConsolidatedQ2: Why do products from different suppliers arrive together?
faqConsolidatedA2: Camion coordinates fulfillment so that eligible products from multiple suppliers can be consolidated into a single shipment.
faqConsolidatedQ3: Can my order arrive in more than one parcel?
faqConsolidatedA3: Yes. Although most eligible orders are consolidated, some products may require separate shipment due to their size, shipping regulations, or operational requirements.
faqConsolidatedA4: Yes. Tracking updates are available through your Camion account Track Order throughout the fulfillment and delivery process.
faqQualityA1: We evaluate suppliers using multiple performance indicators, including business history, customer feedback, ratings, sales performance, product consistency, pricing, returns and overall reliability.
faqQualityA2: Yes. Customers are encouraged to leave honest product reviews and ratings after receiving their orders.
faqQualityQ3: What happens if I receive a poor-quality product?
faqQualityA3: If you experience a product quality issue, please contact our Customer Support team or use Report the Product button on product page through your Camion account. We'll review your case.
faqQualityA4: Yes. Supplier performance is reviewed continuously using customer feedback, return trends, complaint history, and other operational indicators. Suppliers that consistently fail to meet our standards may no longer be sourced.
faqQualityQ5: Can I report an incorrect product listing?
faqQualityA5: Absolutely. If you believe a product description, image, or specification is inaccurate or misleading, you can use Report the Product button on product page through your Camion account or by contacting Customer Support.
faqSupportA1: You can reach us through Live Chat, Email Support or WhatsApp Support.
faqSupportA2: Yes. Our Customer Support team is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
faqSupportA3: Customer Support is currently available in English and Arabic.
faqSupportQ4: Can Customer Support help me track my order?
faqSupportA4: Yes. Our team can help you understand your shipment status and guide you if you experience any delivery issues.
faqSupportQ5: Can I contact Customer Support before placing an order?
faqSupportA5: Absolutely. We're happy to answer questions about products, shipping, payments, promotions, or any other aspect of shopping with Camion before you make a purchase.
faqReportQ1: Can I report a product without purchasing it?
faqReportA1: Yes. If you notice inaccurate information, misleading content, pricing errors, or potential policy violations, you may use Report the Product button on product page even if you have not purchased the product.
faqReportQ2: Will I receive an update about my report?
faqReportA2: Where appropriate, Camion may contact you if additional information is required. Due to privacy and commercial considerations, we may not always be able to share the outcome of every investigation.
faqReportQ3: Can a reported product be removed?
faqReportA3: Yes. If our investigation determines that a product does not meet Camion's standards or violates our policies, we may update, suspend, or permanently remove the listing.
faqReportA4: The more information you provide, the easier it is for us to investigate. Helpful evidence may include photos, screenshots, videos, or a clear description of the issue.
faqTrackQ1: When will I receive a tracking number?
faqTrackA1: Tracking information becomes available once your shipment enters the relevant stage of the fulfillment process. Depending on operational timing, updates may not appear immediately after placing your order.
faqTrackQ2: Why hasn't my order status changed?
faqTrackA2: Some fulfillment stages, such as international transportation or customs processing, may take several days before a new tracking update is available. This does not necessarily indicate a problem with your shipment.
faqTrackQ3: Can I track orders from multiple suppliers?
faqTrackA3: Yes. If your order includes products from multiple suppliers, eligible items are generally consolidated into a single shipment. Your tracking page will reflect the progress of your overall order.
faqTrackQ4: Can my order arrive in more than one parcel?
faqTrackA4: Although Camion aims to consolidate eligible items into one shipment, certain operational circumstances may require products to be delivered separately. If this occurs, your tracking information will clearly indicate each shipment.
faqTrackQ5: What should I do if my tracking information appears incorrect?
faqTrackA5: Please contact Customer Support. We'll work with our logistics partner to review the shipment status and assist you.
